cases.description: When the position is still opened (no exit trade), getProfit() should return zero(). This covers the `if (isOpened())` branch.

When the position is closed (exit trade present), getProfit() must return the gross profit calculated with the exit price minus the position cost. This covers the `else` branch. For example, with an entry trade of 100 units at price 10, an exit trade at price 12, and a position cost of 5, the expected profit is (12‑10) * 100 – 5 = 195.

cases.expected: Num value equal to (exitPrice - entryPrice) * amount (cost model ZeroCostModel, i.e., position cost = 0)
cases.description: Closed long position with zero transaction cost. Entry: BUY 50 units @ 20, Exit: SELL @ 25, CostModel = ZeroCostModel. Expected profit = (25‑20) * 50 = 250.

Closed long position where entry and exit prices are identical, with zero transaction cost. Entry: BUY 100 units @ 15, Exit: SELL @ 15, CostModel = ZeroCostModel. Gross profit = 0, position cost = 0, so profit = 0.

cases.expected: Num value equal to (exitPrice - entryPrice) * amount (negative result)
cases.description: Closed long position that ends with a loss, zero transaction cost. Entry: BUY 30 units @ 40, Exit: SELL @ 35, CostModel = ZeroCostModel. Expected profit = (35‑40) * 30 = -150.

cases.expected: Num value equal to (entryPrice - exitPrice) * amount (positive result for short)
cases.description: Closed short (SELL) position with zero transaction cost. Entry: SELL 80 units @ 60, Exit: BUY @ 52, CostModel = ZeroCostModel. Expected profit = (60‑52) * 80 = 640.

cases.expected: Num value equal to (entryPrice - exitPrice) * amount (negative result for short)
cases.description: Closed short (SELL) position that ends with a loss, zero transaction cost. Entry: SELL 70 units @ 45, Exit: BUY @ 50, CostModel = ZeroCostModel. Expected profit = (45‑50) * 70 = -350.

cases.expected: Num value equal to -positionCost (gross profit = 0, cost > 0)
cases.description: Closed long position where entry and exit prices are equal but a non‑zero cost model is used. Entry: BUY 20 units @ 10, Exit: SELL @ 10, PositionCost = 12 (e.g., commission). Expected profit = 0 – 12 = -12.

Closed position where the exit trade price is NaN. Entry: BUY 10 units @ 5, Exit: price = NaN, any cost model. Gross profit becomes NaN, subtraction of position cost yields NaN, so getProfit() should return NaN.

cases.expected: Num value equal to -positionCost (gross profit = 0 because amount = 0)
cases.description: Closed position with zero amount traded. Entry: BUY 0 units @ 100, Exit: SELL @ 120, PositionCost = 7. Gross profit = (120‑100) * 0 = 0, profit = 0 – 7 = -7.

cases.expected: Num value equal to (exitPrice - entryPrice) * amount – positionCost where positionCost is computed by a non‑ZeroCostModel (e.g., 2% commission)
cases.description: Closed long position using a proportional cost model. Entry: BUY 200 units @ 30, Exit: SELL @ 33, CostModel = 2% of trade value on both entry and exit. PositionCost = (30*200*0.02) + (33*200*0.02) = 120 + 132 = 252. Gross profit = (33‑30)*200 = 600. Expected profit = 600 – 252 = 348.

group: Position.getProfit() - NullPointerException when exit trade is null but position reported as closed

cases.description: Create a Position, manually set its internal 'exit' field to null while mocking/spying isOpened() to return false. Calling getProfit() will attempt exit.getPricePerAsset() and throw NullPointerException.

group: Position.getProfit() - NullPointerException when exit price per asset is null

cases.description: Create a closed Position where the exit Trade object exists but its pricePerAsset is null. getProfit() calls getGrossProfit(null) which internally dereferences the price and throws NullPointerException.

group: Position.getProfit() - IllegalArgumentException for negative exit price

cases.description: Create a closed Position with a valid exit Trade whose pricePerAsset is a negative Num. The underlying getGrossProfit(finalPrice) validates that price must be non‑negative and throws IllegalArgumentException. getProfit() propagates this exception.

group: Position.getProfit() - NullPointerException when cost model is null

cases.description: Create a closed Position with a non‑null exit trade, but set its internal CostModel (used by getPositionCost()) to null via reflection or a test subclass. When getProfit() calls getPositionCost(), a NullPointerException is thrown.

group: Position.getProfit() - RuntimeException from zero() when position is opened

cases.description: Spy on an opened Position and make its private zero() method throw a RuntimeException (e.g., new RuntimeException("zero failed")). Calling getProfit() will take the opened branch and propagate the exception.
